description:
This position is remote within the EMEA region, with the flexibility to work from our Munich or Budapest office.

Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology.

In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work."

We run the way we build: AI-forward, humanistic, and high ownership. We're looking for builders who are energized by complex problems, rapid cycles, and the unique opportunity to see their impact on a global scale.

About You:

  • You are customer focussed and and excited to partner with customers to identify and deliver measurable impact
  • You communicate clearly and effectively across levels, with people from the shop floor to engineering managers to c-level executives
  • You like to solve problems, working closely with colleagues from other departments
  • You have worked for or supported a Life Sciences company and understand their regulatory requirements
  • You have experience in life science development, operations and/or manufacturing environments
  • You Google your way out of most problems, and understand that every customer sees the world a bit differently

What skills do I need?

  • BA/BS (MBA/Masters preferred)
  • 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Product Management, Management Consulting or other client-facing roles in the Life Sciences industry 
  • Experience with change management in a GxP manufacturing and operations
  • Experience creating and leading stakeholder & executive presentations, working with enterprise corporations and multicultural business environments
  • Experience coordinating and leading actions among cross-functional teams (e.g. Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Professional Services)
  • Bias for action and client impact
  • Passion for continuous improvement and digital transformation
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, technology-driven business environment
  • Ability to travel (estimated up to 15%)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage a portfolio of customer accounts by monitoring their adoption, utilization and overall health of their deployment
  • Serve as internal customer champion
  • Guide customers to use Tulip as a tool to improve their operations through digitization, including recommending new use cases, tracking and communicating ROI
  • Act as a trusted partner to customers to ensure and manage contract renewals and support commercial expansion
  • Coordinate across internal teams, from Customer Support, Professional Services, Product Management, and Sales
  • Build and improve internal processes and content, as mechanisms to scale up and mature the Customer Success function

Key Collaborators:

  • Customers
  • Professional Services
  • Customer Support 
  • Sales
  • Product Management
  • Tulip's partners, who may also be supporting an account

Working At Tulip

We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don't match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered. We're building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. 

Benefits of working with us include:

  • Direct impact on product and culture
  • Company equity
  • Competitive benefits package including commuter benefits, learning and development stipend, team events, catered lunches 3 days a week
  • Flexible work schedule and unlimited vacation policy
  • An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues

We are an equal opportunity employer. At Tulip, we celebrate all. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Help us build an inclusive community that will transform frontline operations.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Good production equipment starts with a good process understanding. You will work at the interface between process engineering, mechanical design and the shop floor, and your designs will decide how fast, how safe and how reliable our production becomes.

  • Translate process parameters (pot life, mixing profiles, vacuum levels, flow behaviour) into equipment specifications and design requirements.

  • Create release-quality 3D models, assemblies, drawings and tolerances, and maintain the CAD baseline.

  • Lead design reviews, FMEA and risk assessments together with process safety and quality assurance, and close design-related non-conformances.

  • Work with suppliers and the workshop to build, install and commission equipment, and support process validation and trials.

  • Improve equipment throughput, uptime and cost as we move from pilot to series production.

What we are looking for

  • A degree in mechanical engineering, process engineering or a related discipline.

  • Strong CAD skills (ideally Siemens NX) with clean modelling practice and accurate drawings.

  • Working knowledge of process engineering fundamentals.

  • Experience with design for manufacturability and production ramp-up.

  • Familiarity with FMEA and structured risk assessment.

  • Fluent English. German is an advantage.

Desirable experience

title: (Senior) Customer Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Empower every employee.

KI hat verändert, wie Büroangestellte arbeiten. Bei den 80 % der weltweiten Belegschaft, die nicht am Schreibtisch sitzen, ist sie bisher kaum angekommen. Flip AI ändert das.

Flip AI ist das #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS), mit dem sich jeder Anwendungsfall für Frontline-Teams aufbauen, automatisieren und orchestrieren lässt, auf einem Fundament aus sicherer Identität, Kommunikation und starker UX. In der Praxis heißt das: eine App, über die Frontline-Mitarbeitende in Handel, Produktion und Logistik auf ihre Systeme zugreifen, ihre Prozesse abwickeln und KI nutzen.

Mehr als 1.000 Marken vertrauen Flip AI, und über zwei Millionen Menschen weltweit nutzen die Plattform, bei Unternehmen wie Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA und Greif. Im August 2026 haben Notion Capital und HV Capital mit einer neuen Runde über 25 Mio. US-Dollar erneut investiert, insgesamt sind es damit mehr als 85 Mio. US-Dollar.

Unsere Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.

Stellenbeschreibung

Als Customer Engineer arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen unserem Produkt und der Umgebung unserer Kund:innen: ihrem Identity-Stack, ihren HR-Systemen, ihrem Security Review, ihrer KI-Roadmap. Du bringst einen Tenant von null auf Hunderttausende aktive Nutzende und entscheidest, wie die technische Seite gelöst wird. Manchmal, indem du die Integration designst und die IT auf Kundenseite in die Lage versetzt, sie selbst zu bauen, manchmal, indem du die erste Version selbst baust und sie anschließend übergibst. Dazu gehört der Teil, an dem unsere KI beim Kunden live geht: Agents in der App, Tool-Zugriff über MCP und die Authentifizierungsfragen darunter, die bisher niemand gelöst hat.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Technische Verantwortung von Anfang bis Ende: Du verantwortest die technische Seite unserer Enterprise-Onboardings, vom ersten Architekturgespräch bis zum stabilen Rollout in der Breite.

  • Integrationen, die Flip AI tragfähig machen: Du designst und lieferst Identity und Authentifizierung (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), SCIM-Provisioning, REST-APIs und Anbindungen an HR- und operative Systeme wie SAP SuccessFactors, Workday oder UKG.

  • Beraten und befähigen statt selbst abarbeiten: Du führst die IT auf Kundenseite, ihre Partner und unsere externen Entwicklungspartner zu einer Lösung, die du selbst unterschreiben würdest, und sorgst dafür, dass sie ohne dich betrieben werden kann.

  • Bauen, wo es den Rollout löst: Wo Bauen der schnellste Weg ist, einen Ansatz zu belegen oder ein Rollout wieder in Bewegung zu bringen, baust du die erste Version und übergibst sie danach sauber, mit Dokumentation und Übergabegespräch, damit sie Bestand hat.

  • KI dort, wo sie auf den Kunden trifft: Du gestaltest, wie Agents, Tool-Zugriff über MCP und Agent-to-Agent-Szenarien in echten Enterprise-Umgebungen ankommen, inklusive der Auth- und Datengrenzen, die dabei halten müssen.

  • Technische Autorität im Account: Du stimmst Anforderungen mit Projektleitung, IT, Security, Fachbereichen und Betriebsräten ab, entscheidest die technischen Fragen und gibst die Lücken, die du dabei siehst, an unser Produkt- und Engineering-Team zurück. Rechne mit regelmäßigen Reisen zu Kund:innen, etwa 10 bis 30 Prozent deiner Zeit.

Das bringst du mit

Must-haves

  • Rund 3 bis 5 Jahre (oder mehr) in der IT- oder Tech-Beratung, im Customer Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering oder in der SaaS-Implementierung, mit echter Enterprise-Erfahrung.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Integration und Identity: SSO und Authentifizierung (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID oder vergleichbar), REST-APIs und API-basierte Integrationen, die du in echten Enterprise-IT-Landschaften geliefert hast.

  • Technische Verantwortung am Kunden in Enterprise-Projekten, in denen du die technischen Entscheidungen gemeinsam mit IT, Security und Fachbereichen getroffen und nicht nur koordiniert hast.

  • Echte technische Tiefe, ohne in Vollzeit Produktcode zu schreiben: Du liest Code, prüfst ein Design, debuggst eine Integration und baust einen funktionierenden Prototypen.

  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher und fließendes Englisch.

Nice-to-haves

  • Erfahrung mit SCIM-Provisioning und Anbindungen an HR- oder Workforce-Systeme wie SAP SuccessFactors, Workday oder UKG.

  • Ein fundierter, aktueller Blick darauf, wohin sich agentische KI entwickelt: MCP, A2A, EMA und die Authentifizierungsfragen darunter. Wir suchen jemanden, der das Feld eng verfolgt und eine eigene Meinung dazu hat, keine Jahre an Erfahrung, die es noch nicht geben kann.

  • Vorerfahrung als Customer Engineer oder Forward Deployed Engineer in einem Produktunternehmen statt ausschließlich in der klassischen Beratung.

  • Tools zur Workflow-Automatisierung (n8n oder ähnlich), Routine mit Logs, Metriken und Dashboards oder Erfahrung mit Mitbestimmung und Datenschutz im Enterprise-Umfeld.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Work-Mode: Wir sind remote-first und geben dir damit die Flexibilität, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Gleichzeitig schätzen wir den Mehrwert der persönlichen Zusammenarbeit sehr. Je nach Rolle nimmst du gelegentlich an Team-Events, Workshops oder Meetings in unseren Büros in Berlin oder Stuttgart teil – selbstverständlich immer mit ausreichend Vorlauf. Das genaue Verhältnis besprechen wir transparent während deines Bewerbungsprozesses.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Wir wollen nicht, dass du an deinem Schreibtischstuhl festwächst und übernehmen deshalb die Kosten für deine E-Gym-Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft und bieten Job-Rad Leasing an.

  • Erfolge feiern: Dich erwarten hoch motivierte und engagierte Menschen in einer lockeren Arbeitsatmosphäre.

  • Mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du gestaltest Flip AI aktiv mit. Ganz nebenbei bist du Enabler des rasanten Wachstumsprozesses eines jungen Tech-Unternehmens und wächst an deinen Zielen. Gute Laune garantiert.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Freu dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents und Culture Days, die uns als Flipster zusammenschweißen.

  • Arbeiten im Ausland: Bei Flip AI kannst du auch im europäischen Ausland arbeiten, lass uns im Interview über Workation sprechen.

Damit unsere Stellenanzeigen leichter lesbar sind, verwenden wir im Textverlauf die männliche Form der Anrede. Bei Flip AI sind alle willkommen, ganz egal, welches Geschlecht du hast oder wie alt du bist. Sexuelle Identität, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung und Behinderungen spielen keine Rolle. Das Wichtigste ist, dass DU zu uns passt!

title: (Senior) Customer Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Empower every employee.

AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Flip AI is changing that.

Flip AI is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. In practice, that means one app where frontline workers in retail, manufacturing and logistics access their systems, run their processes, and use AI.

More than 1,000 brands trust Flip AI, and over two million people use it worldwide, at companies like Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA and Greif. In August 2026, Notion Capital and HV Capital doubled down with a new $25M round, bringing our total funding to more than $85M.

Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.

Job Description

As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap. You take a tenant from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. That includes where our AI goes live: agents in the frontline app, tool access over MCP, and the authentication questions underneath them that nobody has solved yet.

What you can expect

  • Technical ownership end to end: You own the technical side of enterprise onboardings, from the first architecture conversation to a stable live rollout at scale.

  • Integrations that make Flip AI load-bearing: You design and land identity and authentication (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), user provisioning (SCIM), REST APIs and connections into HR and ops systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.

  • Advise and enable instead of absorb: You bring the customer's IT, their partners and our external development partners to a solution you would sign off on, and you make sure they can run it without you.

  • Build where building unblocks: Where building is the fastest way to prove an approach or to unblock a rollout, you build the first version and then hand it over cleanly, with the documentation and the handover conversation that make it stick.

  • AI where it meets the customer: You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers, including the auth and data boundaries that have to hold around them.

  • Technical authority in the account: You work with customer project management, IT, security, functional departments and works councils, you decide the technical questions, and you feed the gaps you see back into our product and engineering teams. Expect regular travel to customer sites, roughly 10 to 30 percent of your time.

What you bring to the table

Must-haves

  • Around 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments.

  • Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them.

  • Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype.

  • German at C1 level or above and fluent English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Provisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.

  • An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. We are looking for someone who follows the field closely and has an opinion, not for years of experience that cannot exist yet.

  • Prior work as a Customer Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer at a product company, rather than in classic consulting only.

  • Workflow automation tooling (n8n or similar), comfort with logs, metrics and dashboards, or experience with German co-determination and enterprise data protection.

What we offer you

  • Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.

  • Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing.

  • Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere.

  • Be part of something bigger: You actively shape Flip AI in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Stay tuned for regular team events and culture days that bring us together as Flipsters.

  • Working abroad: At Flip AI you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview.

At Flip AI, everyone is welcome - no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity, origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip AI. The most important thing is that YOU fit in!

title: UI/UX Software Engineer
description:
Join SE3 Labs as a UI/UX Software Engineer

Design and build intuitive, high-performance interfaces for autonomous systems, turning complex operational capabilities into software that people can use confidently in the real world.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our future, help us build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field

About the Role

As a UI/UX Software Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll take ownership of how our software looks, feels and performs. Your core challenge is to build one coherent interface system that works across many contexts: different devices, screen sizes, plugins and product features, from large command displays to small field devices with limited computing power. You’ll combine UX/UI design with hands-on front-end development, working closely with our software team. From integrating 3D visualisations to building interfaces for military personnel in the field, you’ll help shape a product from the ground up and see the direct impact of your work.

What You’ll Work On

  • Coherent UI System & Front-End Architecture: Design and build a modular, well-structured front-end and a consistent design language that spans our whole product range. Make it easy to add new plugins and features, and to run on different systems and devices, without losing consistency or maintainability.

  • UX/UI Design & Implementation: Work with the team to understand user needs, design and wireframe interfaces, and turn them into working software. Own both the user experience and the code that brings it to life.

  • Multi-Device & Performance: Build interfaces that adapt across small screens, tablets and large displays, and stay responsive on resource-constrained hardware. Identify bottlenecks, optimise rendering and deliver a smooth experience without relying on high-end devices.

  • 3D Visualisation Integration: Integrate 3D visualisations into the user interface so that they work smoothly alongside other features, including on devices with limited computing resources.

  • Plugin & Feature Interfaces: Build reusable UI components for different plugins and product features, so that third parties and internal teams can extend the platform in a consistent way.

  • Usability for Operational Environments: Help design interfaces for military personnel working in demanding conditions. Consider intuitive workflows, clear information hierarchy and established conventions such as NATO symbology. Learn from real user feedback and improve continuously.

  • Collaboration & Product Evolution: Work closely with the software team to understand customer needs and translate them into design and engineering decisions. Help shape how the interface evolves as the product grows, and look for ways to simplify workflows and make new capabilities easier to understand.

Your Profile

  • You enjoy building a coherent system rather than a single screen: one design language and one component structure that works across many plugins, systems and devices.

  • You bring hands-on experience designing and implementing user interfaces for software products, with a focus on intuitive, usable experiences across different devices and screen sizes.

  • You have built structured, responsive and maintainable front-end applications, not just static designs or isolated prototypes, and you know how to organise code into reusable components and modular structures.

  • You can move between UX/UI design and software development, turning wireframes and requirements into working interfaces and making informed decisions about both usability and implementation.

  • You care about performance as well as appearance, and you work methodically to improve the experience across different hardware.

  • You work well with engineers and other stakeholders, explore different approaches and turn ideas into practical solutions.

  • You take initiative, enjoy open-ended problems and want to help build and shape a product rather than maintain an established interface.

  • You’re interested in software for real-world use, where clarity, reliability and ease of use matter as much as visual design.

  • You’re happy to work on-site with the team in Munich.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • 3D Visualisation: Experience integrating interactive 3D visualisations into software interfaces, particularly using Unreal Engine or similar technologies.

  • Performance on Constrained Hardware: Experience optimising front-end applications for low-compute devices, limited resources or demanding real-time requirements.

  • Complex Operational Interfaces: Experience designing interfaces for complex systems where users need to interpret spatial information, symbols or multiple sources of information quickly.

  • Gaming or Real-Time Visualisation: Experience in 3D gaming, motorsport, simulation or other fields where responsive interfaces and real-time visual feedback are important.

  • Building from Scratch: Experience establishing a front-end architecture, reusable component system or coherent design language for a new product or platform.

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 minutes): An initial conversation to discuss your experience, motivation and interest in SE3 Labs, alongside an introduction to the role and our working environment.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes): Discuss your experience, approach to software development and UX/UI design, and how you would contribute to the team.

  3. Technical Deep Dive (90 minutes): Explore your technical capabilities in more detail, including front-end architecture, interface design and implementation, responsive development and problem-solving.

  4. Team Lunch or Dinner: Meet members of the team, get a feel for how we work together and learn more about life at SE3 Labs.

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a high-energy, relentlessly optimistic Account Executive with proven experience in SaaS and the real estate/proptech sector. You are a confident “hustler” who sees the glass as half full and thrives in a high-activity sales environment.

This is a pure new business role where you will own a defined territory and named-account set in the DACH region. You will control the pipeline you create and oversee the commercial outcome of every deal from the first conversation to the final signature. Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management, and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product, and senior executive support.

The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, and typically take six to nine months to close. Initial deal values range from £25k to £100k and have clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning requires a strong business case, quantified value discovery, and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT, and finance.

Core Capabilities & What You Will Own

Strategic Navigator & Deal Execution

  • Deeply understand account politics and decision-making structures to “connect the dots” within complex opportunities.

  • Ensure opportunities are qualified to a MEDDICC standard, featuring a quantified business case and direct access to the economic buyer.

  • Ensure every material deal is multi-threaded so that it survives any change of internal sponsor.

  • Lead commercial negotiations that build value and protect price, rather than defaulting to discounts.

  • Apply rigorous qualification to make early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process, or route to decision.

Relationship Builder & “Land and Expand”

  • Cultivate strong connections and effectively influence key stakeholders across your target audience.

  • Scope first wins so they can grow, ensuring sites, countries, and use cases are sequenced from the start.

  • Execute a clean handover to Customer Success with a fully documented expansion path.

Market Educator & Alliance Builder

  • Proactively educate market participants and win strategic partners to build valuable alliances.

Driven Execution, Pipeline & Coverage

  • Maintain a high volume of sales activity with resilience, confidence, and a proactive mindset.

  • Take personal responsibility for territory coverage, hitting a new business quota mapped out by a strategic territory plan.

  • Build pipeline through business development, marketing, partner channels, and self-generated activity.

  • Lead diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance, and risk.

Forecasting and Governance

  • Maintain a robust forecast with stage integrity, next steps, and close dates you confidently stand behind.

  • Surface risks early with an honest view of what has changed and what is needed.

  • Contribute to the sales playbook with competitive intelligence, repeatable use cases, and objection handling.

What Excellent Performance Looks Like

  • Commercial Outcomes: Hitting new-logo ARR against quota, robust pipeline creation, territory coverage, and securing strategic logos. Strong win rates against incumbents or “no decision” outcomes, driving high average deal values and total multi-year value.

  • Operating Standards: High forecast accuracy, multi-threading, MEDDICC quality, price protection, discount discipline, CRM quality, and process discipline.

Your First 12 Months

  • First 90 days: Complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage, and create the first qualified opportunities.

  • By six months: Achieve credible coverage against a ramped quota, progress multi-threaded opportunities through evaluation, and close (or materially advance) a first customer win.

  • By 12 months: Deliver against a ramped quota, establish a repeatable pipeline-creation motion in your territory, and land accounts with clear expansion potential.

What We’re Looking For

  • Typically five or more years in B2B software or complex technology sales, including a sustained period carrying a new business quota (quality of results matters more than years).

  • Evidence of sustained over-performance in new business sales: quota attainment, team ranking, pipeline personally created, and representative deals won (we will ask for specifics).

  • The ability to walk us through significant deals end-to-end: how the opportunity was created, how the buying group developed, what changed, and why it was won or lost.

  • A structured seller who uses MEDDICC (or a comparable methodology) in practice.

  • Strong results combined with the forecast and CRM discipline required to run a predictable business.

  • English and German at a business level is a hard requirement.

  • Experience in CAFM, IWMS, FM, PropTech, or multi-site operations is a strong advantage.


Package, Support, and Progression

  • Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and meaningful accelerators for over-performance.

  • Comprehensive support including business development coverage, Pre-Sales, marketing, and enablement to support your success.

  • Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching, and fast commercial decisions without a committee.

  • Structured onboarding, methodology training, and deal coaching, starting with a fairly ramped quota.

  • Clear progression into global accounts or sales leadership, as we back elite individual contributors as readily as future managers.

This role is for an accomplished new business seller who wants the autonomy to build a territory, the support to win complex enterprise deals, and real reward for over-performance. If you have created pipeline, won meaningful customers, and run a disciplined process, we would like to hear from you.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

title: Founding LPA Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Applicants from the EU and non-EU are welcome to apply

▪ Industry: Deep-tech / Active Muon Imaging & Laser-Plasma Accelerators

▪ HQ & Locations: Hamburg (DE) – HQ; Tallinn (EE)

▪ Size: 1–10 employees

Company Mission

The company develops safe, rapid and accurate active muon imaging solutions for industrial quality assessment, security and customs inspection and medical diagnostics. Their platform combines laser-plasma-accelerator-driven muon sources, next-generation particle detectors and AI to enable high-resolution 3D imaging with automated decision-making. The company operates at DESY in Hamburg, Germany, and Tehnopol in Tallinn, Estonia. Their main development partners span the energy, defence, aerospace and security industries. Their initial technology and business focus is on the quality and safety assessment of critical metallic and ceramic components, such as rocket engines, gas turbines, jet engines, and large-scale nuclear or industrial systems.

Core Values

Skunkworks approach: They work in small teams with full ownership. They keep it simple, stupid. Move fast: a shiny prototype means they spent too long on it. They build to learn. They polish later. Disagree together, commit together: they debate and challenge, regardless of title. Then they deliver the decision as one team. They win as a team. They pivot as a team.

Courage: they always make the call. A mistake isn't a failure: it's proof they're improving. Either way, the own the outcome. Honesty and transparency: they share what's really happening, good or bad. That lets everyone make the right call. They stay open. They stay honest.

Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Assemble and lead the Muon Source team, covering LPA, converter, and optics; start hands-on, hire and structure the team as the work grows

  • Oversee the development of working points and a density-tailored plasma source that survives the thermal load of a 100 Hz, 100 TW focus—millions of consistent shots, not one good shot

  • Lead the development of the plasma source and execute experiments at user facilities to iterate the design toward powering the transportable muon source

  • Isolate the laser specs that matter most—pulse energy, duration, pointing and energy stability, beam quality—and ensure they get delivered

  • Own the vacuum system and the laser transport line, including vacuum chambers, differential pumping, vibration management and thermal management, turning the LPA into a machine that fits inside a shipping container and runs 24/7

  • Define the requirements for the control system, the machine protection system, and the diagnostics suite that let the machine run unattended

  • Manage the budget and make technical decisions within your area of responsibility

  • Participate in hiring processes to expand the Muon Source team as the scope grows

Requirements

  • Team leadership. You've built and led a technical team before. You're ready to be hands-on again before this one exists

  • Hands-on LPA experience. You've built and operated a laser-plasma accelerator. Not just modeled one. Injection, dephasing, depletion, and guiding physics you've tuned on real hardware

  • Experimental leadership at user facilities. You've planned and run a multi-year experimental campaign before. You know how to iterate a design from real beamtime data

  • High-power laser system literacy. You can write a spec a laser manufacturer can build to: pulse energy, duration, pointing and energy stability, beam quality. You hold vendors to it

  • Vacuum and opto-mechanical engineering judgment. You know what vacuum chamber design, differential pumping, vibration isolation, and thermal management require to keep the LPA running under continuous, high-average-power use

  • Controls and diagnostics systems thinking. You can translate "runs unattended, 24/7" into concrete requirements for a control system, a machine protection system, and a diagnostics suite, even where another team builds them

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years postdoc experience

  • Doctorate (PhD / Dr.) required

  • At least full professional proficiency in English; German or Estonian is a plus

  • Willingness to work primarily on-site in Hamburg (no full remote; approximately one home-office day per week)

  • Occasional travel required to visit and work at different research facilities across the world

  • Ability to start in January 2027 or latest February 2027

Core Benefits

  • Key Role with Direct Impact: Without your LPA, our core product – the transportable muon source – cannot operate

  • Founding Role with High Autonomy: Build both the accelerator team and the machine from the ground up, taking full ownership of technical and budget decisions

  • Unique Deep-Tech Challenge: Hands-on work with laser-plasma accelerators at 100 Hz / 100 TW and active muon imaging technology that is revolutionizing industrial inspection

  • Access to World-Class Infrastructure: On-demand beamtime at multi-GeV facilities such as DESY PRIMA, plus collaborations with ELI Beamlines, EPAC, and ATLAS

  • Strong Network & Visibility: Collaborate with leading partners such as DESY, DLR, Siemens Energy, Marvel Fusion, and other high-tech organizations

  • Attractive Compensation Package plus a substantial employee equity program and relocation support, including for non-EU candidates

  • Culture of Ownership & Speed: A skunkworks approach, flat hierarchies, bold decision-making, and full transparency create an environment for personal growth

title: Projektleiter Rechenzentrumsbau (m/w/d)
description:
Über innovIT AG

Die innovIT AG denkt Rechenzentren neu: schneller geplant, modular aufgebaut und technisch präzise umgesetzt. Hinter unseren Lösungen steht ein Team mit mehr als 15 Jahren Erfahrung in Planung, Bau und Betrieb von Rechenzentren – alle Gewerke kommen aus dem eigenen Haus.

Unsere Rechenzentren entstehen modular – und jemand muss dafür sorgen, dass am Ende alles zusammenpasst. Du steuerst unsere Projekte vom ersten Kabel bis zur Abnahme.

Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst RZ-Bauprojekte gewerkeübergreifend – von Elektro (USV, NSHV, NEA) über Kälte und Brandschutz bis zur IT.

  • Du bist Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden – vom Projektstart bis zur Abnahme.

  • Du hakst nach, wenn Leistungen oder Mängel offen sind, und machst jedes Projekt besser als das letzte.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Projekt- oder Bauleiter in Handwerk, Bau oder Anlagenbau

  • Fundierte Elektro-Kenntnisse, idealerweise in gesicherter Stromversorgung (USV, NSHV, NEA)

  • Abschluss als Techniker, Meister oder Ingenieur mit technisch-handwerklichem Hintergrund

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, Reisebereitschaft und Führerschein Klasse B

  • Strukturiert, redegewandt, kundenorientiert – und du bleibst dran, bis es passt

  • Hier baust du, was gerade die Welt bewegt: Rechenzentren für KI und Datenanalyse – modular, energieeffizient und jedes Projekt anders

  • Ein erfahrenes Team aus Infrastruktur- und RZ-Spezialisten mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen

  • Langfristige Perspektive mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem wachsenden Technologiefeld

  • Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung, sowie hochwertiges Smartphone und Laptop

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und 30 Tage Erholungsurlaub

  • Home-Office und flexible Arbeitszeiten

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.

We do not partner with search firms.

 

About

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Engineering team and help build and improve the products and systems behind Lokalise. You'll work closely with Product, Design, other engineers, and stakeholders to identify and solve meaningful customer problems, improve existing experiences, and shape what we build next.

Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, uncover their pains and needs, define their own goals, and choose how to solve the problems that matter most. We're hiring across multiple domains, so you'll own a real piece of the product and see your impact firsthand.

We're building an AI-native engineering culture where engineers take ownership of problems, not just implementation. We expect you to question assumptions, challenge decisions, contribute to product direction, and find better ways to solve customer problems.

You'll use AI throughout the development process to move faster without compromising quality. Your responsibility doesn't end when code reaches production. You'll care about whether what we built actually works, delivers value, and solves the problem we set out to address.

 

You Will

  • Own problems end to end, from discovery and design to production and iteration. You take initiative instead of waiting to be told.
  • Build, test, and maintain features across the stack, with clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
  • Build modern applications with React, TanStack Router, and modular-react on the frontend, and Node.js, Fastify, Drizzle on the backend.
  • Work in a Dockerized TypeScript environment with Vitest and Playwright for testing.
  • Partner with Product and Design to shape what we build, focusing on outcomes for customers rather than sheer output.
  • Champion AI-native engineering across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and help the team raise the bar on speed and quality.
  • Run what you build by taking part in the on-duty rotation for the services you're responsible for and leading the improvements that keep them reliable.
  • Mentor other engineers and champion engineering excellence.

 

You Must Have 

  • 5+ years of experience building and maintaining production software, with strong hands-on experience in Node.js, TypeScript, and React, and the ability to work across different systems and technologies.
  • Strong full-stack fundamentals: modern frontend architecture (component design, state management, performance), API design, message queues (SNS/SQS, RabbitMQ, or similar), relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), and cloud (AWS or similar).
  • Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar). You've developed effective ways of working with AI to move faster, solve complex problems, and deliver high-quality software.
  • A strong product engineering mindset. You build with the customer in mind and measure success by the impact you deliver, not the tasks you close.
  • A strong sense of ownership. You're self-driven, proactive, and accountable for results well beyond the merge.
  • Strong collaboration skills. You work effectively with engineers, Product, Design, and other stakeholders to solve problems together. You share knowledge, give and receive constructive feedback, challenge ideas respectfully, and help others succeed.
  • A track record of leading complex projects end to end, from technical design to production rollout.
  • Strong quality and testing habits (unit, integration, and beyond) that let you ship fast without breaking things.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication skills, attention to detail, and a genuine drive to keep learning in a fast-paced, remote setting.

 

It's a Plus If You Have

  • Experience working in an open-source community as a maintainer or a contributor.
  • Familiarity with the localization industry and software localization. 

 

Our Benefits

💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.
🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.
🏢 Co-working budget — for those days you want a change from your home office.
🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.
🖥️ Home office setup budget — monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.
📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.
🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.
🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.
🤝 Great startup culture — remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses.

title: Financial Crime Oversight & Remediation Manager
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.


Role overview

Complex merchants can create complex financial crime risks. Their corporate structures, operating models and control environments may span entities, jurisdictions and teams. When concerns emerge, effective action depends on more than identifying the issue: someone must bring the right people together, agree a credible response, and keep remediation moving until it is complete.

As Financial Crime Oversight & Remediation Manager, you will provide that ownership. You will coordinate targeted oversight of higher-risk or strategically important merchant relationships, helping turn concerns into clear, proportionate and evidenced plans. You will work across Compliance, Financial Crime Investigations, onboarding, commercial and operational teams, and, where appropriate, directly with merchants. Your judgement will matter: you will need to know when a proposed control or remediation is credible, when evidence is insufficient, and when an issue needs escalation.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines financial crime compliance expertise with strong delivery discipline. You will help address issues early, support defensible decisions, and give complex remediation the structure and follow-through it needs.

What you’ll do

  • Own targeted remediation coordination. For complex merchant concerns, bring together the relevant internal teams, clarify the problem and desired outcomes, agree accountable owners and milestones, and maintain a practical plan through to closure. Track dependencies and slippage, challenge gaps, escalate material blockers and confirm that completion is supported by evidence.

  • Coordinate Compliance-imposed conditions. Track material financial-crime conditions attached to product, market or other approval decisions. Work with the relevant Compliance and business owners to confirm accountability, milestones and evidence of completion; identify slippage or gaps; challenge whether evidence demonstrates the condition has been met; and escalate overdue or inadequately evidenced actions through the agreed governance route. The relevant delivery owner remains accountable for implementing the condition.

  • Coordinate enhanced oversight of merchants. Support a structured watch-list approach for merchants whose risk or control environment warrants closer attention than routine, risk-tiered monitoring, but where immediate termination or a formal investigation is not necessarily the right response. Help define the oversight plan, review progress and ensure concerns do not remain unresolved or without an owner.

  • Assess remediation quality. Review proposed actions and evidence against the underlying financial crime concern and relevant regulatory expectations. Identify whether controls appear appropriately designed and operating, whether further evidence or testing is needed, and whether residual concerns require escalation or a change in the relationship’s risk treatment.

  • Engage merchants constructively. Where appropriate, work with account teams to agree clear requests, expectations and timelines with merchants. Maintain a firm, evidence-led approach while supporting a proportionate path to address weaknesses and establish whether the relationship can be sustained safely.

  • Lead enhanced control reviews. Design and, where appropriate, lead deeper reviews of a merchant’s AML controls during onboarding or ongoing oversight. This may include preparing agendas, conducting structured discussions with merchant stakeholders, probing key control areas, documenting findings and agreeing any required remediation.

  • Support reliance and outsourcing assessments. Contribute to the initial scrutiny of outsourced activities or other arrangements that depend on another party’s controls. Help establish whether reliance is justified, what evidence supports that view, and what conditions or remediation are required.

  • Improve the oversight approach. Capture recurring issues, lessons and delivery gaps, and help refine processes, reporting and escalation so that complex concerns receive consistent, timely and well-evidenced attention.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in financial crime compliance, AML, or a closely related risk and control role, with a sound understanding of AML control frameworks and how to assess their design and effectiveness.

  • Experience coordinating complex remediation, regulatory or audit actions, control reviews, investigations follow-through, or comparable cross-functional change. You can turn an ambiguous issue into a sequenced plan with clear owners, milestones and evidence of completion.

  • The confidence and judgement to challenge senior stakeholders and merchants constructively, distinguish a credible response from a paper commitment, and escalate when progress or evidence is inadequate.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to lead structured discussions, document findings clearly and translate complex issues into practical actions.

  • Excellent organisation and follow-through across multiple workstreams, with a pragmatic approach to prioritisation, dependencies and changing circumstances.

  • A collaborative style and the resilience to work through sensitive, commercially significant issues without losing sight of the control outcome.

  • Experience with structured project management methods, such as Lean Six Sigma or PRINCE2, to drive organised execution across complex workstreams is a strong plus.

Experience with complex merchants, payments, cryptoassets, money service businesses, correspondent or outsourced service models would be valuable. Relevant professional qualifications are welcome but are not a substitute for sound judgement and demonstrated delivery.

Why this role

You will work at the point where financial crime risk, merchant relationships and practical execution meet. The role offers meaningful ownership of issues that cut across teams and can shape whether concerns are resolved early, managed with appropriate safeguards, or escalated on a sound evidential basis. Success is visible in the quality of the decisions and the fact that agreed actions are actually completed.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM) at Checkout.com, you will manage a portfolio drawn from our largest and most strategic enterprise merchants. TAM coverage is reserved for a select group of accounts, and you will work on them alongside our Account Management (AM) team. You will be responsible for the technical relationship, and together with the AM you will grow and maintain every account in the portfolio. You do that by unlocking the technical elements, removing friction from our technical products and, most importantly, making sure each customer has the best possible payment performance and technical health, so the commercial relationship can grow.

What you'll be doing:

  • Customer Partnership: Be the primary technical point of contact for the merchants in your portfolio. Build trusted relationships with their technical and product teams and run the technical part of quarterly business reviews, while the AM owns the commercial relationship and pricing.

  • Payment Performance: Monitor acceptance rates, decline patterns and authentication results across your portfolio, find what is costing merchants approvals and fix it.

  • Technical Consultancy: Root-cause decline spikes, integration errors and configuration problems using log monitoring and data querying tools, and see them through to resolution. Collaborate with issuers, card schemes and our internal teams that manage those relationships to resolve systemic issues.

  • Product Adoption: Lead the rollout of new products, payment methods and technical migrations as merchants expand with Checkout.com.

  • Account Growth: Spot growth opportunities in your merchants' roadmaps and collaborate with the AM on the best way to position new products and solutions. Strengthen upsell conversations with demos, workshops and technical training on new features.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with many teams across Checkout.com, including Product and Engineering, to translate merchant requirements into clear action items that deliver better outcomes for the customer, such as improved payment performance.

Qualifications

  • 3 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, managing internal and external stakeholders up to senior level.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex and unfamiliar technical issues independently and drive them to resolution.

  • Comfortable with core technical concepts, such as APIs and how front-end and back-end systems work together, and able to explain them clearly when advising merchants.

  • Strong data literacy, with the ability to use query tools and AI to analyse data, extract insights and turn them into improvements.

  • Experience with data querying and logging tools such as Datadog and BigQuery.

  • Comfortable using AI tools and agents in your day-to-day work to investigate issues faster, automate repetitive tasks and scale your impact.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to client sites as required.

  • Experience in payments or SaaS (software as a service) is a plus.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the team

We’re building Strategy & Operations in the CEO Office to help Product and Engineering deliver the right work, at pace and with fewer surprises. Product sets what to build and why. Engineering builds it. S&O keeps the full picture in view, brings teams together and helps turn plans into results.

As S&O Lead, you’ll own that work across a product pillar and help raise the bar for how the wider S&O team operates. The impact is visible: what you improve in your pillar can shape how Checkout delivers elsewhere.

The role

This is a high-ownership role. You’ll be accountable alongside the product leader for delivery, but you won’t own the roadmap. You’ll need to earn alignment, challenge commitments and stay close to the work. When priorities collide, you’ll help decide what moves, what waits and what stops.

You will:

  • Keep the pillar’s major initiatives in view. Know what matters, what is slipping and where teams are blocked. Raise risks early and bring a clear point of view.

  • Be a trusted, independent partner to the product leader. Challenge dates and trade-offs, and help agree what to protect, move or stop. Product retains roadmap decisions.

  • Personally lead the pillar’s hardest cross-functional work, from getting teams aligned through to launch.

  • Build and lead the S&O team in your pillar. Hire, develop and manage performance, while setting practical standards that help S&O deliver better across Checkout.

What you'll do

  • Own execution across the pillar. Keep priorities, delivery tempo, progress, dependencies and risks visible. Spot when plans are off track and bring a clear recommendation.

  • Build deep expertise in the pillar’s products: how they work, who they serve and how they make money.

  • Challenge priorities and commitments with the product leader. Recommend what to protect, re-sequence, move or stop. The product leader owns roadmap and commit-date decisions.

  • Personally lead the pillar’s most important cross-functional initiatives, aligning Product, Engineering and partner teams and driving the work through launch to enable faster shipping

  • Lead and develop the S&O team supporting the pillar. People leadership is core to the role, including hiring, development and performance management. Alongside pillar delivery, help shape practical standards adopted across S&O.

What you'll bring

  • You have strong problem solving and analytical skills. You can frame an ambiguous business question, build the analysis yourself, test hypotheses, quantify trade-offs and turn findings into clear business decisions.

  • You move between strategy, hands-on delivery and building the organisation. You personally lead high-impact, cross-functional work and stay accountable through launch and results.

  • You make execution repeatable. You build practical operating mechanisms and use data, automation or AI where they remove recurring friction or help teams scale.

  • You influence without relying on authority. You challenge senior stakeholders constructively, communicate complex issues clearly and bring people to decisions.

  • You raise the performance of others. You set clear expectations, give direct feedback and help people grow. Prior formal line-management experience is helpful, but evidence of leadership matters more.

Strongly preferred:

  • Payments, fintech or regulated money-movement experience would be a real advantage, especially if you’ve worked with licences, regulators, schemes or banking partners. It can help you see risks sooner and get up to speed faster. It isn’t a requirement: strong operators from other sectors can be a great fit.

What this role is not:

  • Not support to the product leader. You own execution across the pillar and need to push back when commitments don’t add up.

  • Not a short-term consulting project. You stay with the work through delivery and build ways of working the team can keep using.

  • Not a product role. Product sets the roadmap. Engineering builds the product. You make sure the pillar executes well.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Front-end Focus - Growth
description:
🚀 About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with a front-end focus who has experience working with commercial. You’ll turn a marketing campaign, a pricing test or a new product launch into a fast, reliable experience, then measure whether it worked.

Your main focus will be zoe.com and our acquisition and conversion journeys, including landing pages, checkout, sign-up and product launches across our app subscriptions and physical products. You’ll spend most of your time in TypeScript, React and Next.js, and you’ll work in our backend services (Kotlin or Python) whenever a feature needs it.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We’re looking for someone who works autonomously, makes sound decisions independently and takes full ownership of their work.

💻 Our Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, React, GraphQL

  • Backend: Kotlin / Spring Boot, Python / FastAPI and Django

  • Tools: DatoCMS / headless CMS, Optimizely / AB testing tools, Grafana, Sentry, Firebase Auth

  • CI/CD: ArgoCD, GitHub Actions

  • Data: web data layer, dbt, BigQuery

  • Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Vercel

👥 About the Team

You’ll join ZOE’s Growth team, which drives how people discover, learn and become a member. Growth sits where engineering meets the commercial side of the business. We work closely with marketing, CRM, product, design and analytics to turn ideas into experiments, and experiments into results.

Our wider Engineering team is a distributed across the UK and EU, with skills spanning web, mobile and backend engineering, machine learning, data science and analytics. We’re proud of the diversity in our team: 39% female and 61% male, with colleagues from many backgrounds, cultures and lived experiences. We believe this makes us stronger, more creative and better able to serve our global community.

Above all, we value curiosity, openness and empowerment. We encourage everyone to share ideas, keep learning and shape how we work.

🎯 What you’ll be doing

  • Owning growth initiatives end to end: from shaping the idea with commercial partners, through technical delivery, to measuring the result.

  • Partnering with commercial teams: working day to day with marketing, CRM and product to deliver campaigns, launches and acquisition journeys, often to tight, business-critical deadlines.

  • Running experiments: designing, launching and analysing A/B tests with our analysts, and using the results to decide what to build next.

  • Building a fast, high-converting zoe.com: owning web performance, accessibility and conversion across key journeys such as landing pages, sign-up and checkout.

  • Adapting to changing priorities: making pragmatic trade-offs when plans change, and helping the team decide what to build, what to defer and what to drop.

  • Working across the stack: shaping APIs and making backend changes where growth features need them, in Kotlin or Python.

  • Contributing to the design system: helping grow our shared component library so the team can ship consistent experiences quickly.

  • Shipping continuously: releasing to production daily, often more than once, with the testing and monitoring in place to do so safely.

🧠 We think you’d be great if you…

  • Have 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on front-end.

  • Have strong experience with TypeScript, React and Next.js, and know how to build fast, accessible and well-tested web experiences.

  • Have worked closely with commercial functions such as marketing, growth, sales or CRM, and enjoy turning business goals into product outcomes.

title: Sales Coordinator (French and English speaking)
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Sales Coordinator to join our Hospitality Sales team based in Paris. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing and approving all new sales opportunities, along with processing software returns, and adjustments, all the while supporting the local Paris sales teams with administrative tasks post sales. You’ll need to thrive on complex problems and be a quick learner and team player to help keep this machine running.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Provide insight and support to members of the Sales teams for opportunity processing.

  • Review, consolidate and reconcile orders, contracts and payments. 

  • Process hardware shipments.

  • Work with customers to resolve billing and subscription inquiries.

  • Review reports to monitor and boost team efficiency and streamline daily operations. 

And a little bit of.... 

  • Ensure that sales meet financial and legal requirements.

  • Contribute to wider company initiatives, and projects outside of daily tasks.

  • Handle other duties and responsibilities as defined by management.

What you need to bring:

  • Experience in an administrative function

  • Experience in a SaaS and/or technology-related field

  • Knowledge of Mac OS X, iOS, G Suite, Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack

  • Remarkable communication skills

  • Perfect written and spoken French and English

  • Team player who works collaboratively to achieve common goals

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

What’s in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

  • Ability to do your job in a truly flexible environment;

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs everyday;

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact.

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed share scheme (we are all owners)

  • Pension fund

  • Axa Health insurance 

  • Health and wellness benefit of 400 EUR/year

  • Mental health online platform and counselling & coaching services

  • 25 vacation days per year

  • Paid leave and assistance for new parents

  • Volunteer day

  • Public transport benefit

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.
